outcome: Mean time to first rescue analgesic administration
cohort: Obstetric patients undergoing elective cesarean surgery under spinal anesthesia were included in the study.
finding: Using tramadol as an adjuvant with bupivacaine for intrathecal route significantly extended the duration of the pain-free period after subarachnoid anesthesia compared to 4 mg dexamethasone added to intrathecal bupivacaine.
